description: Establish a green baseline. Confirm the toolchain works and the repo builds/lints/typechecks cleanly BEFORE making any Bucket C changes, so later regressions are attributable. Also record the current counts for the code-quality sweep issues (console.error/console.log/console.warn/any/eslint-disable/window.location.href) so later features can prove they reduced them.
steps: Load nvm in every shell: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; then verify `node --version` reports v22.x.
If node_modules is absent, run `npm install` from the repo root.
Run `npm run typecheck` and capture the result. If it is not clean on a fresh checkout, record the pre-existing errors in findings so they are not blamed on later work.
Run `npm run lint` and capture pass/fail plus warning count. Note the quality:lint budget is --max-warnings 46.
Run `npm run test:unit` and capture pass/fail. If the unit suite has pre-existing failures unrelated to Bucket C, record them in findings and treat them as the baseline.

Record baseline metric counts (put exact numbers in findings): `grep -rc 'console.error' app/api --include=*.ts | wc -l` and total occurrences; occurrences of console.log/console.warn under app/ and components/; occurrences of no-explicit-any eslint-disable under app/ page files; occurrences of window.location.href under app/ and components/; number of files importing lib/api-error.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run typecheck` result is recorded (pass, or a documented list of pre-existing errors).
`npm run lint` result and warning count are recorded.
Baseline occurrence counts for the code-quality metrics are written to the feature findings.

environment.node_modules: was MISSING on fresh checkout; ran `npm install` (added 1441 packages, OPEN_INTERNET). npm audit reports 7 vulnerabilities (1 low, 6 moderate) - pre-existing, not addressed as part of this baseline.

verification_results.typecheck: PASS - `npm run typecheck` (npx tsc --noEmit --pretty) clean, 0 errors.
verification_results.lint: PASS - `npm run lint` (eslint .) exits 0 with 0 errors and 153 warnings. The `lint` script has NO --max-warnings cap so it passes; the `quality:lint` script uses --max-warnings 46 and would FAIL at 153 warnings. Warning breakdown by rule: @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any = 94, unused-imports/no-unused-vars = 48, react-hooks/exhaustive-deps = 11 (remaining ~0). A large share of the any/unused warnings live in tests/unit/* files. Later features must NOT increase these counts.
verification_results.test_unit: PASS - `npm run test:unit` (vitest run tests/unit tests/dashboard): 327 test files passed, 5387 tests passed, 0 failures. No pre-existing failures. Note: some tests emit benign stderr noise ([Cache] Redis not configured, using in-memory cache) - expected, not a failure.
